answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed tasks that counterparties verify, with each verified completion extending a reputation trail tied to costly, rate-limited deposits. Splitting into fresh identities does not multiply trust: each newcomer starts at the nadir, and deposits are locked until disputes resolve. A sybil operator must fund every identity and recruit real counterparties to vouch through work, paying fees and tying up capital; a plume of fake accounts gains no weight. Even at a wharf, one colluding seller cannot cheaply certify them all.
